name: voice-ai-agent-optimizer
description: Agent Optimizer for HighLevel Voice AI agents: analyzes past call transcripts, generates test cases, and recommends configuration changes.

scripts.build:server: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/db/schema.sql dist/db/schema.sql && cp src/db/seed-data.sql dist/db/seed-data.sql
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui && rm -rf dist/ui && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp -r src/ui/dist dist/ui/dist
